recorded_findings: M0-09 retained 30 raw assets (10,653,285 bytes); pass 2 added none. Its 0 acquisition exceptions are distinct from unresolved legal coverage. `changed` and `failed` are proven by offline lifecycle regressions, not by claiming they occurred in this successful live pilot.

M0-10A retained 13 publication events, two selected amendment acquisitions and one evidence-backed candidate invalidation; no live unresolved target exception was emitted. This bounded historical-day check is not continuous monitoring or complete amendment history. Later PP No. 491 resync stayed stale, including a changed metadata observation followed by unchanged replay.

M0-10 candidate review: 0 admitted, 2 rejected, 3 unresolved. PP No. 354 has a text-edition/applicability-overlay mismatch; PP No. 491 is stale; the other acts retain temporal, amendment or consolidated-coverage blockers. Positive gold snapshot labels do not remove those blockers.

Recorded human review cost: approximately 80 minutes (1.33 hours) for five acts, plus 120 minutes (2 hours) for 30 gold labels; approximately 200 minutes (3.33 hours) total. Mean act effort: 16 minutes; mean gold-label effort including corrections: 4 minutes. These are bounded pilot observations, not total engineering cost or a reliable full-project forecast.

Acquisition resource cost is measured as requests, bytes and wall time above. Monetary cost, engineer-hours, OCR-only time, electricity and a complete all-run cost ledger were not recorded; they remain unknown, not zero. The pilot does not use a billed LLM API. Bulk-source access remains blocked under the recorded source policy.

M0-11 metadata records 30 reviewed labels, 15 working / 15 closed, zero outstanding disputes and private-local storage approval at 2026-10-01T19:54:03+05:00. Complete dataset/working/closed/split/review files are verified by hash only; the closed labels are never loaded.

The retained M0-08 handoff replay produces the same candidate bytes and ID on new then unchanged. The synthetic offline example freezes edition-candidate/1 byte serialization. Both are contract verification, not approval of PP No. 354.

The M0-10 measurement failure is binding: exact per-act review start/finish and exception-only minutes are absent. A human Legal Reviewer must repeat the affected review with those measurements and update its decisions; M1 remains blocked until the report is reassessed.
